## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `bun run lint` and it passes.
- [ ] I ran `bun run build` and it passes.
- [ ] I tested the change in a browser (golden path + at least one edge case).
- [ ] No user files are uploaded or sent off-device by this change.
- [ ] I used Shilp Sutra design tokens, not raw Tailwind primitives.
- [ ] I read the relevant Next.js 16 docs in `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` if I touched routing/config.
- [ ] If I added a tool or preset, I registered it in the appropriate file under `src/lib/presets/` or `src/lib/tools.ts`.
